scope: Installed Linux x86-64 native-ruby-task-v1 gems; local candidate evidence for VO 1223, 1222 and 1221.
toolchain: Lean 4.32.2; MRI 3.3.12; glibc 2.36; RubyGems with Fiddle. The installed programs run with no compiler or build tools on PATH.
checks: Ordinary Lean source and independently selected reviewed IR yield identical public interfaces and distinct source trees and gem archives. Two stream-only factories are installed from a separate Lean application.

All 19 primitive input/result shapes are delivered through tasks. Checks distinguish a returned nested Except, an immediate typed factory failure, a selected terminal IO failure and a stream-step failure. Pure, BaseIO and IO companions remain direct calls.

MRI fibers share pending and settled tasks; individual waits park on IO readiness. Cancellation wakes both waiters even when the Lean worker ignores cancellation. Retirement wakes a parked fiber before the worker can complete.

Stream pulls exercise backpressure, concurrent pull refusal, block exceptions, early break, empty and exhausted streams. Frozen owners work, copied and fork-inherited owners are rejected, and explicit close and abandoned-owner cleanup return observed live identities to zero.

Each exact gem is installed offline and relocated. Inner file sizes and digests are checked before exercising retained clients. A disposable installed library with one additional byte is rejected on the next require.
controls: Separate fresh builds reject a retained Ruby callback and a non-IO.Error terminal selection with declaration-specific diagnostics, without creating a release directory.

An explicitly supplied invalid gem version is rejected unchanged. With neither a Lake version nor gem coordinates, an original platform gem installs offline as lean-bad 0.0.0. Plain require loads it and the Lean-produced task returns 37.
limits: This profile does not support retained Ruby callbacks, nominal resource leases or foreign host-object imports. It is not a whole-matrix gate or hosted CI result.
Only the listed synchronous companions, task/cursor declarations and value shapes were exercised. The operating system, VM and toolchain are part of the profile.

reproduce.tools: Set LEAN_BRIDGE_RUBY to MRI 3.3. A build also needs the pinned LEAN_BRIDGE_LEAN_PREFIX and a C compiler. Replay needs MRI, all three original handoffs, their three client files and the original acceptance.json.
